text:
At least 19 people were booked at an Orleans Parish facility on Aug. 1
At least 19 people were booked at a facility in Orleans Parish, Louisiana, on Aug. 1, 2026.
The most common listed charge was "RS 14 000 WARRANT," which appeared in five charge entries. "RS 14 35.3 DOMESTIC ABUSE BATTERY" also appeared three times among the top listed charges.
Booking records show the charges listed at the time of booking. Individuals listed have not been convicted of any charge based on this record.
